name: Views for Elementor Forms – Display & Edit Submissions on your site frontend
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
ElementorView for Elementor Forms allows you to display, search, paginate, and even edit Elementor Forms entries right on the frontend of your site — no need to access the WordPress admin panel.

You can design how the data appears using Elementor’s visual builder, including table, list, or grid layouts, and control which users can view or edit their own entries.

DEMO: https://demo.add-ons.org/views-for-elementor-forms-display-edit-elementor-forms-submissions-on-your-site-frontend/
DOCUMENTATION: https://add-ons.org/document-views-for-elementor-forms/

Features

  • Display Elementor Forms submissions on the frontend.
  • Choose between Table, List, or Grid layouts.
  • Pagination and search filters.
  • View single entry details.
  • Edit entries directly from the frontend.
  • Secure update with nonce verification and user ownership checks.
  • Supports Elementor repeater controls for flexible layout customization.
  • Built-in responsive controls for width and spacing.
  • Developer-friendly with filters and hooks.

Perfect for

  • User dashboards showing their submitted forms.
  • Frontend submission management.
  • Custom “My Account” pages.
  • Collaborative data viewing (e.g., job applications, contact logs, etc.).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/views-for-elementor-forms.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor and create or edit a page.
  4. Search for the widget “ElementorView – Form Entries” and drag it into your layout.
  5. Choose your Form ID, layout type (Table / List / Grid), and configure display options.
  6. Save and preview on the frontend.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with frontend view and edit capabilities.
  • Supports table, list, and grid display types.
  • Added pagination, search, and nonce-protected editing.
